# Arena biomes

24 complete definitions.

## BIO-001 Raincourt

**Visual identity:** Blue slate terraces and copper gutters

**Materials:** Water, Metal

**Environment rule:** Every 8 s a 0.5 s visible rainfall pulse adds one water unit to the two mirrored 2 m gutter beds, up to four. No rain wets players automatically.

**Tactical use:** Build connected wet lanes or ground their electricity; central slate stays dry.

**Fairness:** Dry routes remain on both flanks; wet cells are marked in preview.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** water, metal

## BIO-002 Ember Orchard

**Visual identity:** Charred fruit trees and black basalt

**Materials:** Heat, Growth

**Environment rule:** Two mirrored 2 m root beds start with Heat 1 and Growth 1. Their fuel is exhausted after one ignition unless a player adds growth.

**Tactical use:** Burn temporary growth to open cover or quench the route.

**Fairness:** Anchored trunks do not burn; both sides receive equal fuel.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** heat, growth

## BIO-003 Glass Observatory

**Visual identity:** Clear prisms and rotating brass star maps

**Materials:** Light, Metal

**Environment rule:** Two anchored prisms allow one reflected ray at 70% retained damage. Their orientation is fixed for the duel and shown in preview.

**Tactical use:** Aim at predictable reflected lanes or break prism durability.

**Fairness:** Reflections cannot strike spawn alcoves or loop.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** light, metal

## BIO-004 Rime Foundry

**Visual identity:** Frosted iron plates and furnace shells

**Materials:** Frost, Metal

**Environment rule:** Two shallow mirrored water tiles begin frozen with 45 durability. They thaw normally; no automatic refreeze.

**Tactical use:** Use melt-to-steam transitions or shatter ice into a short cone.

**Fairness:** Central floor is rough stone and never slippery.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** frost, metal

## BIO-005 Moss Archive

**Visual identity:** Shelves of stone tablets and living vines

**Materials:** Growth, Water

**Environment rule:** Each mirrored porous wall absorbs its first water unit and releases it to one adjacent floor cell when struck for 20 damage.

**Tactical use:** Store water in cover for a later reaction.

**Fairness:** Only marked porous cover has this behavior; no hidden water store.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** growth, water

## BIO-006 Thunder Causeway

**Visual identity:** Conductive rails over stable rock

**Materials:** Storm, Metal

**Environment rule:** Four visible 3 m rail sections conduct a bounded electrical branch, stopping at insulated gaps.

**Tactical use:** Redirect a chain through a rail or stand in its insulated gap.

**Fairness:** No rail reaches a spawn or the entire final circle.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** storm, metal

## BIO-007 Silt Basin

**Visual identity:** Damp sand around ruined fountains

**Materials:** Sand, Water

**Environment rule:** Two 2 m beds start with Sand 2 Water 1; their damp state suppresses dust for 3 s, then decays without refill.

**Tactical use:** Dry a bed to raise dust or maintain a clear approach.

**Fairness:** Rough stone bypasses both beds; no mandatory slow.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** sand, water

## BIO-008 Moon Cloister

**Visual identity:** Pale walls with alternating light shafts

**Materials:** Light, Shadow

**Environment rule:** Two marked light shafts reduce a shadow field lifetime by 1 s per second; ambient darkness never hides a player itself.

**Tactical use:** Place concealment outside bright patches or push an enemy into light.

**Fairness:** Brightness and contrast remain equivalent on all graphics settings.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** light, shadow

## BIO-009 Resonance Hall

**Visual identity:** Stone ribs and suspended acoustic bells

**Materials:** Sound, Earth

**Environment rule:** Two acoustic plates ring for 1 s when hit by a player or damaging prop; the ring gives public direction without revealing through-wall silhouettes.

**Tactical use:** Mask or bait movement with a timed bell impact.

**Fairness:** Both players hear identical public rings; no auto-target.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** sound, earth

## BIO-010 Floating Quarry

**Visual identity:** Anchored stepping rock and gravity lamps

**Materials:** Gravity, Earth

**Environment rule:** Two 2 m low-gravity pads reduce fall damage by 50% while standing on them and show an overhead marker. No jump-height bonus.

**Tactical use:** Use predictable safe landings or deny a pad.

**Fairness:** Pads do not alter server projectile velocity or grant flight.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** gravity, earth

## BIO-011 Windmill Yard

**Visual identity:** Canvas sails and sandy cobble

**Materials:** Force, Sand

**Environment rule:** Every 12 s an announced 2 s gust moves clouds up to 2 m along the shown compass direction; force strength 1.

**Tactical use:** Plan a shifting screen or expose a protected approach.

**Fairness:** The gust does not move players or damaging props.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** force, sand

## BIO-012 Copper Baths

**Visual identity:** Shallow baths and grounded statues

**Materials:** Water, Storm

**Environment rule:** Each grounded statue absorbs one electrical branch, then loses its grounding for 4 s with a bright overload cue.

**Tactical use:** Spend a branch to exhaust safety or preserve a protected route.

**Fairness:** No full-map conduction; max propagation remains 6 m.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** water, storm

## BIO-013 Briar Greenhouse

**Visual identity:** Glass arches and trimmed living cover

**Materials:** Growth, Heat

**Environment rule:** Two 60-durability hedge panels may burn for 2 s before crumbling; they have one finite fuel layer.

**Tactical use:** Choose whether to remove a flank screen or use its brief burn.

**Fairness:** No critical support is combustible; exits remain open.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** growth, heat

## BIO-014 Mirror Steps

**Visual identity:** Polished ramps and opaque mirror slabs

**Materials:** Light, Arcane

**Environment rule:** Mirrors reflect non-damaging spell preparation flashes only as public visual decoys; actual rays reflect only at marked prisms.

**Tactical use:** Use visible false flash direction to bait a peek.

**Fairness:** Mirror art never presents a fake damaging projectile or false collision.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** light, arcane

## BIO-015 Ash Amphitheatre

**Visual identity:** Terraced basalt with dusty channels

**Materials:** Heat, Sand

**Environment rule:** Two dust beds begin Dust 2. A water unit suppresses one layer; a force impact above 20 raises a 3 s dust field.

**Tactical use:** Create a brief screen from terrain rather than a spell slot.

**Fairness:** Each bed can raise one field before its dust is exhausted.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** heat, sand

## BIO-016 Fungal Vault

**Visual identity:** Luminous caps and porous pillars

**Materials:** Venom, Growth

**Environment rule:** Two marked caps release a 1 m 2 s cloud dealing 4 corrosive damage/s when destroyed; each cap is one-use.

**Tactical use:** Deny a tiny route or clear a cap before approach.

**Fairness:** Clouds affect either player, remain visible, and cannot cover every route.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** venom, growth

## BIO-017 Oath Cemetery

**Visual identity:** Stone markers and spirit lanterns

**Materials:** Spirit, Earth

**Environment rule:** Each lantern shatters once into a 2 s 1.5 m public silhouette illumination field; it reveals no player through solid cover.

**Tactical use:** Illuminate a nearby concealed flank or remove the lantern.

**Fairness:** Lanterns are symmetric and cannot heal or grant resources.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** spirit, earth

## BIO-018 Clockwork Atrium

**Visual identity:** Pendulum decor and brass shutters

**Materials:** Metal, Arcane

**Environment rule:** Two shutters switch open/closed at combat 20 s and 40 s with 2 s warning. A player in a closure path causes that shutter to remain open.

**Tactical use:** Time a lane crossing or cast as a sightline opens.

**Fairness:** Shutters stop switching before boundary contraction and never seal a route.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** metal, arcane

## BIO-019 Blackwater Dock

**Visual identity:** Wood decks over bounded dark pools

**Materials:** Water, Shadow

**Environment rule:** Two 2 m pools are visually dark but use ordinary Water 2 states; visible edge patterns preserve readability.

**Tactical use:** Use water reactions without pretending darkness gives invisibility.

**Fairness:** Every deck has two safe exits; liquid is shallow.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** water, shadow

## BIO-020 Sunforge Gallery

**Visual identity:** White stone and warm metal screens

**Materials:** Heat, Light

**Environment rule:** Two heat sinks absorb the first 2 heat units touching their face, then stay visibly hot for 3 s without automatic damage.

**Tactical use:** Spend heat to warm a reaction surface or use it as limited shielding.

**Fairness:** Absorption is finite and does not remove direct projectile damage.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** heat, light

## BIO-021 Crystalline Grotto

**Visual identity:** Faceted rock and brittle shelves

**Materials:** Frost, Sound

**Environment rule:** Two 45-durability crystal covers fracture under a 20+ impact, producing the standard 10-damage shard cone.

**Tactical use:** Break cover from a chosen angle rather than randomly exploding it.

**Fairness:** Only directional nearby shards deal damage; main ceiling is anchored.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** frost, sound

## BIO-022 Red Dune Court

**Visual identity:** Cloth canopies and heavy sand urns

**Materials:** Sand, Force

**Environment rule:** Two medium urns spill a 2 m Dust 1 patch on destruction, finite once each. Wind can move its 3 s obscuration.

**Tactical use:** Choose where to break an urn to shape sight.

**Fairness:** Canopies are visual only; solid cover remains obvious.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** sand, force

## BIO-023 Magnetic Depot

**Visual identity:** Insulated crates and conductor coils

**Materials:** Metal, Gravity

**Environment rule:** Two fixed coils deflect eligible physical projectiles by at most 10 degrees in a 1.5 m radius after a 0.25 s visible pulse on impact.

**Tactical use:** Trigger a small predictable deviation before the next shot.

**Fairness:** One pulse percoil/4 s; no target-seeking and no beam bend.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** metal, gravity

## BIO-024 Wellspring Forum

**Visual identity:** Circular masonry and sealed ritual basins

**Materials:** Arcane, Water

**Environment rule:** Two basins hold Water 2 and release one unit to an adjacent floorcell per direct impact, maximum two releases each.

**Tactical use:** Control a finite water supply with aimed hits.

**Fairness:** No health/mana pickup; direct-hit procs cannot trigger on basins.

**Sizes:** 24, 32, 40, 48

**Tags:** arcane, water

# Interactive props

48 complete definitions.

## PROP-001 Copper Barrel

**Category:** Conductive

**Mass:** medium

**Durability:** 60

**Effect:** Stores one electrical branch; its shell glows for 0.25 s before a 1 m pulse dealing 12 electrical damage. One pulse per 4 s.

**Tactical use:** Push it into a wet route, or trigger it from beyond the pulse.

**Counterplay:** The source, state, and footprint are visible. Push it into a wet route, or trigger it from beyond the pulse.

**Placement:** Mirrored or resource-equivalent pair; never the only route, spawn floor, or final-circle support.

**Tags:** storm, metal

## PROP-002 Grounding Statue

**Category:** Conductive

**Mass:** anchored

**Durability:** 80

**Effect:** Absorbs one incoming chain branch, becomes ungrounded for 4 s, then visibly resets. It does not absorb unrelated direct damage.

**Tactical use:** Use its finite grounding to cross a charged lane.

**Counterplay:** The source, state, and footprint are visible. Use its finite grounding to cross a charged lane.

**Placement:** Mirrored or resource-equivalent pair; never the only route, spawn floor, or final-circle support.

**Tags:** storm, earth

## PROP-003 Segmented Rail

**Category:** Conductive

**Mass:** anchored

**Durability:** 90

**Effect:** Conducts along its marked 3 m length; insulation breaks prevent further travel. The source supplies all reaction damage.

**Tactical use:** Break one segment or move beyond the marked contact strip.

**Counterplay:** The source, state, and footprint are visible. Break one segment or move beyond the marked contact strip.

**Placement:** Mirrored or resource-equivalent pair; never the only route, spawn floor, or final-circle support.

**Tags:** storm, metal

## PROP-004 Iron Bell

**Category:** Conductive

**Mass:** medium

**Durability:** 45

**Effect:** An electrical hit produces an audible public ring for 1 s and spends one branch. No additional damage beyond the source.

**Tactical use:** Bait sound direction or consume a limited branch.

**Counterplay:** The source, state, and footprint are visible. Bait sound direction or consume a limited branch.

**Placement:** Mirrored or resource-equivalent pair; never the only route, spawn floor, or final-circle support.

**Tags:** storm, sound

## PROP-005 Coil Stand

**Category:** Conductive

**Mass:** anchored

**Durability:** 70

**Effect:** One electrical hit charges a visible 1 m zone for 0.6 s, dealing 8 reaction damage once to each player entering. Cooldown 4 s.

## BLD-001 Measured Crossfire

**Exclusive owner:** WIZ-001

**Objective:** Hold a stable firing lane, prepare the focus reward behind cover, and reposition before the opponent can rush the same angle twice.

**Equipped spell ids:** SPL-001, SPL-002, SPL-003, SPL-004, SPL-005, SPL-006

**Equipment ids:** EQP-001, EQP-051, EQP-081, EQP-099, EQP-096

**Augment ids:** AUG-149, AUG-155, AUG-020, AUG-289, AUG-293, AUG-292

**Draft plan:** Round 1: AUG-149 First Savings rank 1 (free), Round 3: AUG-289 Prism Banking rank 1 (free), Round 5: AUG-155 Spell Recharge rank 1 (free), Round 7: AUG-293 Shard Ward rank 1 (free), Round 9: AUG-020 Magnum Opus rank 1 (free), Round 11: AUG-292 Single Spectrum rank 1 (free)

**Equipment cost:** 1200

**Equipment interactions:** EQP-001 Surveyor's Point: After aiming without sprinting for 0.6s, the next direct projectile travels 10% faster. If no projectile spell is equipped, the prepared cast instead gains 5% shorter preparation., EQP-051 Training Cuirass: Maximum health increases 15., EQP-081 Road Soles: Sprint speed increases 3%, within +20% cap., EQP-099 Sundial Fragment: One spell equipped in slot 1 has 8% shorter cooldown, counting toward 25% permanent reduction cap., EQP-096 Pocket Reservoir: Maximum mana increases 8.

**Transformation interactions:** AUG-289 changes SPL-001: Ray can reflect once from a mirror prop at 27 damage; reflected segment visible., AUG-293 changes SPL-003: Breaking ward leaves a 20-health light shard for 2 s; next enemy contact within 0.8 m takes 12., AUG-292 changes SPL-002: Replace fan with one 0.7 m ray dealing 38.

**Sequence:** The first direct spell is a probe; alternate two different spells rather than repeatedly spending the heaviest ray. Use the defensive kit action to preserve the next preparation.

**Mastery connection:** Keep the aim vector within a 2-degree cone for the final 0.25s and release with rings aligned: next direct spell gains 12% projectile speed, or 12% lower windup for nonprojectile spells, never both. Moving targets still require manual tracking.

**Counterplay:** Cover and changing elevation deny the stable reticle window.

**Constraints:** Six free selections: two Silver, two Gold, two Prismatic. All transformations target this wizard’s equipped spells. Equipment purchases respect round tier unlocks; the plan is a possible draft result, not a guaranteed shop outcome. All global caps apply.

**Tags:** worked-build, WIZ-001
